data.title: 7 Siblings Borrows 20 Million USDS From Spark to Buy 12,085 ETH
data.description: 7 Siblings borrowed 20 million USDS from Spark eight hours ago and bought 12,085 ETH at $1,655 per coin. According to Odaily, on-chain analyst Ember reported that the address 0x5ffc...33c37 has spent 85.96 million U over the past half-month to buy 46,528 ETH at an average price of $1,847 per coin, and currently has an unrealized loss of $10.75 million.

data.title: Fairmint Plans Tokenized Stock Trading Platform on Canton, With Ethereum to Follow
data.description:
Fairmint plans to launch Fairmint TSV, a tokenized stock trading platform, under the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission’s five-year Innovation Exemption framework. According to Foresight News, citing CoinDesk, the platform will initially support Canton Network and later plans to add Ethereum, with trading focused on issuer-authorized tokenized stocks.

Fairmint’s SEC-registered transfer agent, Fairmint TA, will handle shareholder identity verification, share transfers and on-chain ownership records. Tradecraft will serve as the platform’s first automated market maker (AMM).

Trading has not begun. The platform’s launch is subject to meeting the Innovation Exemption requirements, signing agreements and completing operational preparations. The launch date, initial stocks and eligible participants have not been announced.

data.title: AguilaTrades' BTC Short Earns Another $6.87 Million as 10-Day Rolling Short Turns $610,000 Into $10.21 Million
data.description:
AguilaTrades’ BTC short position earned another $6.87 million, while a 10-day rolling short strategy turned $610,000 into $10.21 million.

According to Odaily, on-chain analyst Ember said the trader, whose address is 0x1f250Df59A777d61Cb8bd043c12970F3AFE4F925, increased the amount about 17-fold by rolling BTC short positions over the past 10 days. The source said AguilaTrades lost $39 million through rolling trades last year and has recently recovered about $10 million through the strategy.

data.title: Capricor Study Reportedly Had Serious Deficiencies; Company to Announce Next Steps After Review
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, Capricor Therapeutics said its resubmitted biologics license application for Deramiocel received a complete response letter from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. The FDA said the available data did not provide substantial evidence of efficacy and cited other clinical deficiencies, including serious deficiencies in the Deramiocel study. Deramiocel is an investigational cell therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

CEO Linda Marbán said the company was disappointed for patients and their families. She said the HOPE-2 and HOPE-3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials both met their primary endpoints, and that the company had confidence in the rigor of the trials and the integrity of the data, which it believes support approval. Capricor is reviewing the letter and will announce next steps after completing its assessment.

As of September 30, 2026, Capricor had approximately $198.5 million in cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash and marketable securities, which the company said would fund planned operations for at least 12 months. The company is reviewing operating expenses to extend its cash runway.

data.title: Block Report: 72% of U.S. Square Bitcoin Payments Occur at Restaurants
data.description: A Block team published a report on Bitcoin payments using data from U.S. Square merchants over the past year. According to PANews, the report found that the median payment was about $13, with 42% of payments below $10 and nearly two-thirds below $20; 72% took place at food and beverage merchants. Coffee shops and fast-food restaurants accounted for 62.6% of Bitcoin payment volume at food businesses, with a median payment of $9.10. Grocery stores had a smaller share of payment frequency but the highest average transaction amount, at $60.73.

data.title: Entity’s Nine Addresses Hold ETH and BTC Longs With More Than $65.47 Million in Unrealized Losses
data.description: Nine addresses linked to an unidentified entity continue to hold long positions of 60,841.22 ETH and 600 BTC without reducing them, with unrealized losses exceeding $65.47 million. According to Odaily, the entity made more than $67.05 million from long positions between April and August this year, but has since given back all of those gains.

data.title: Santiago Roel Santos Sees ETH Falling to the $100s Within Two Years
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Inversion founder Santiago Roel Santos predicts ETH could fall into the $100s over the next two years. He said ETH has not reached that range because it still has a strong base of supporters, but believes a lack of coordination between Ethereum’s product and technical leadership, along with senior leaders’ dismissive stance toward DeFi, is weakening that support.

Santos contrasted Ethereum with Solana, which he said has taken the opposite approach, and cited Solana’s acquisition of CoinGecko.

data.title: predict.fun Lists Hornets’ NBA Road Win Probability Against Hawks at 52%
data.description:
The probability of the Charlotte Hornets defeating the Atlanta Hawks in an NBA regular-season prediction event on predict.fun was listed at 52%. According to Odaily, the teams were playing in the second quarter of their 2026-2027 season game, which also counts toward NBA Cup group play, with the visiting Hornets leading 46-36. The game began at 8 a.m. today.

Before the game, Atlanta ranked fifth in the Eastern Conference with a 9-6 record and was on a two-game winning streak after beating the Oklahoma City Thunder 117-112. Charlotte was 4-10 and 12th in the conference, had lost three straight, and had won once in its previous 10 games.

In the teams’ first meeting this season, Atlanta beat Charlotte 128-81, a 47-point margin. In NBA Cup group play, Atlanta was 1-1 and Charlotte was 0-2.

data.title: AI | Anthropic Researcher Says Claude Helped Solve Riemann Problem
data.description: On the heels of Anthropic’s record-breaking initial public offering, a researcher at the company said he believes he used Claude to solve the Riemann problem, a number theory question that has challenged mathematicians for more than 150 years, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Strategy Reports $35 Billion in Net Reserves, Says All Bitcoin Holdings Are Unpledged
data.description:
Strategy, the Bitcoin treasury company, said its net reserves were negative during the 2022 bear market, when about one-third of its Bitcoin holdings were used as collateral. According to Odaily, the company weathered the downturn and later strengthened its financial position.

Strategy said its net reserves now stand at $35 billion, and none of its Bitcoin is pledged as collateral. The company said its conviction in Bitcoin and financial flexibility are at their highest levels ever.

data.title: Stripe Agent Wallet Daily Spending Rises Nearly 80-Fold Since Early September
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Stripe Chief Economist Ernie Tedeschi shared the company’s tracking data on consumer agent commerce as the first holiday season with agent-assisted shopping in 2026 approaches. Link Agent Wallet enables personal agents including Muse, Instinct and Grok to make payments. Its daily spending, measured by a seven-day rolling average, was nearly 80 times higher in mid-November than in early September and doubled over the past month.

Last week, more than 40% of Link agent spending went to airfare, travel and lodging, about one-third to retail and roughly one-quarter to other categories. More than half of consumers who completed an agent-assisted purchase returned for at least a second purchase, usually in the same spending category. Stripe said it will continue tracking the data as Black Friday and Cyber Monday approach and plans to share further updates.

data.title: Fidelity’s Jurrien Timmer: Bitcoin Is More Like a Speculative Asset as S&P 500 Correlation Rises
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Fidelity Investments Global Macro Director Jurrien Timmer said Bitcoin has performed poorly recently, with its correlation to the S&P 500 rising significantly in recent weeks. He said Bitcoin is trading more like a speculative risk asset than a monetary asset, reflecting both monetary and speculative factors.

Timmer pointed to the growth rates of Goldman Sachs’ basket of unprofitable technology stocks and the global money supply. Bitcoin has tended to rise sharply when both expand rapidly, and vice versa, he said. The AI theme is currently pulling back, risk appetite is declining, and global liquidity is also easing.

data.title: U.S. Government Wants Ukraine to Reach Peace Deal With Russia by Early January
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, citing people familiar with the matter, the U.S. government wants Ukraine to reach a peace agreement with Russia by early January next year, ahead of Democrats taking control of Congress.

U.S. officials have recently held intensive meetings with Russian, Ukrainian and European officials, emphasizing the urgency of reaching an agreement. European countries want a ceasefire before discussions on security arrangements, while Russia has not committed to expanding the scope of negotiations.

data.title: Formula Founder Says Current Pullback Resembles May 2021 Crypto Deleveraging, Keeps Cash for Opportunities
data.description:
Formula founder Vida said in a post that he deployed another 3% of his funds today, leaving 87% in cash. According to Odaily, Vida is highly optimistic about the market but plans to control his trading pace and wait for better entry opportunities.

Vida said the current market pullback resembles the crypto market in May 2021: industry fundamentals have not worsened, but the market needs to go through a deleveraging process.

If the Nasdaq-100 ETF (QQQ) falls another 5% to 10%, Vida plans to raise his position to about 20%. If it drops 10% to 20%, he will consider increasing the position to 30% to 40%.

Vida said he will not quickly use up his cash reserves, even with a highly bullish market view. He would consider investing more only in an extreme market environment similar to 2008, 2020 or 2022, with QQQ down more than 40% to 50% from its peak and global assets broadly trading at steep discounts. He also said he would not use leverage in the future.

data.title: El Salvador Troops Killed in Haiti Explosion After Rescue Deployment
data.description: According to Bloomberg, two Salvadoran soldiers died in Haiti after an explosion struck an area where they were working. The blast came weeks after President Nayib Bukele ordered a large deployment to the Caribbean nation to search for missing troops.

data.title: Databricks in Early Funding Talks at $225 Billion Valuation
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, Databricks is in early talks for a new funding round that could raise several billion dollars and value the data analytics software provider at about $225 billion post-money, people familiar with the matter said. The talks are ongoing, and terms could change. The proposed valuation is nearly 20% above the $190 billion valuation in its previous round in August.

A completed round would indicate continued investor interest in AI startups despite growing concerns among some investors about the pace and scale of the AI boom and a broad selloff in AI stocks. Founded in 2013, Databricks is one of Silicon Valley’s most valuable startups and is viewed as a potential near-term IPO candidate. Investors consider Anthropic’s IPO a gauge of the AI market; strong share performance could spur a wave of AI company listings.

Databricks said in August that its annualized revenue had surpassed $7 billion. The metric extrapolates a full year’s revenue from short-term figures, and fast-growing companies often consider it more informative than full-year financial results.

This summer, Databricks launched Genie One, an AI agent that helps customers find information in their own business data and supports decision-making. The company also released Unity Gateway, a tool that lets businesses access various AI models and track related technology spending. In addition to open-weight models, it supports models developed by OpenAI, Anthropic and Google.

Databricks’ investors include Coatue Management, Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, Insight Partners, Fidelity Investments and JPMorgan Asset Management.
